en.topic_title: Tropical Storm Champi nears China after battering Taiwan, Japan
en.topic_summary:
A powerful storm swept towards China on Saturday after battering Taiwan and Japan’s southernmost islands, knocking out power to thousands of households and forcing the cancellation of hundreds of flights.



A temporary structure built for a traditional Taoist religious ceremony lies collapsed due to strong winds from Typhoon Champi in Keelung on October 24, 2026.  Photo: I-Hwa Cheng / AFP.



Typhoon Champi was downgraded to a tropical storm as its wind speed dropped to 102 kilometres (63
